title: Members CLI for the waitlist and enablement
description:
**Phase 3 of 7.** Bootstrap path for enablement. 5744ef cannot seed the first organization, and 7b4616 cannot close the door, without this CLI.

- **Blocked by:** b574a6
- **Runs in parallel with:** every other phase-3 task
- **Unblocks:** 5744ef, then 7b4616

---
python -m chatticus.members with list --status pending, enable, suspend, and role. This is the admin surface for v1; there is no admin UI. Organization records are data, not infrastructure, so writing them from a CLI does not violate the CDK-only rule for AWS resources.

**Done when:** an operator can list pending organizations and enable one against development.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Heads-up before this surfaces a semantic that is not settled yet.**

`enable_organization` in #130 writes `ENABLED` from any prior state, so it approves a pending organization and reinstates a suspended one through the same call. A review note on b574a6 asks for those to be separated.

For this CLI: do not expose a single `members enable` that can do both. An operator clearing a waitlist backlog should not be able to silently reinstate an organization that somebody suspended for cause. Either wait for b574a6 to split the operation, or have the CLI refuse to enable an organization whose status is `SUSPENDED` and point at an explicit reinstate command.

Everything else on this card stands, and it is the right thing to be working: 41d08d unblocks 5744ef, which 7b4616 cannot be called done without.
